goals.notes: The qualifying window for the 2027 race ends with the Staten Island Half on October 11, 2026.

routes.detail: A half marathon in 1:21:00 or faster (men 18-34) at an NYRR race: the NYC Half, Maybelline Women's Half, RBC Brooklyn Half or NYRR Staten Island Half. Guaranteed entry. A certified half marathon run elsewhere also counts, but only for a limited number of spots.

routes.detail: Complete four qualifying NYRR events in 2026 as a member (the last one is the NYRR Staten Island Half on October 11, 2026) for guaranteed entry. It is nearly too late for 2027.

routes.detail: Anyone can apply to the general drawing, with no guarantee. NYRR members are also in a member-only second-chance drawing.

goals.name: TCS New York City Marathon
goals.notes: Qualifying runs for the 2027 race must happen in 2026, so the window is closing soon.

routes.detail: A marathon in 2:53:00 or faster, or a half marathon in 1:21:00 or faster (men 18-34), by net time, between January 1 and December 31, 2026. Guaranteed entry if run at an in-person NYRR marathon or half. At another certified marathon you join a limited pool, and if it fills only the fastest in each age and gender group get in. Half marathon qualifiers must be an eligible NYRR half (NYC Half, Maybelline Women's Half, RBC Brooklyn Half, Staten Island Half). Your age on race day (November 7, 2027) sets the standard.
routes.title: Run a qualifying time

routes.detail: In calendar year 2027: nine qualifying NYRR races, one volunteer shift, and an active NYRR membership through December 31, 2027, for guaranteed entry to the 2028 marathon. Joining the program is now limited to about 15,000 members chosen by a free drawing (this year's ran September 17-29, 2026, drawn October 1; you had to be a member by September 16).
routes.title: 9+1 program

routes.detail: The general drawing, charity teams and tour operators also exist. See NYRR for the current rules.

goals.name: Boston Marathon
goals.notes: The 2027 window opened September 13, 2025 and registration has closed. The next window is not confirmed here: check baa.org.

routes.detail: A certified full marathon in 2:55:00 or faster (men 18-34), by net (chip) time. Only a full marathon counts: shorter races, time trials, treadmill and handicapped marathons do not, and the course must be certified (USATF, AIMS or the national equivalent). The standard is set by your age on race day.
routes.title: Run a qualifying time

routes.detail: Meeting the standard only lets you apply; acceptance is not guaranteed. For 2027 you had to beat it by 5 minutes 17 seconds (2:49:43 or faster for men 18-34). Registration for 2027 closed September 18, 2026, and it was not first come, first served.
routes.title: The cut-off

routes.detail: Charity numbers and other routes exist. See baa.org for the current rules. The qualifying window for the following Boston is set by the B.A.A. each year, so check before you run your qualifier.
